name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires holding the box on the exit step (carry to the exit), and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking the box up again after each fall. All are hard, as the task's wording requires; nothing is added, missing, or redundant.

texts: The agent reaches the exit at least once.
Every time the agent stands on the exit, it holds the box on that step or later, so the box is carried to the exit.
Whenever the box falls, the agent holds the box again on that step or later (it picks the box up again).
